#Daily_Brief: #Somalia’s parliament speaker says country’s security inseparable from #Djibouti’s

Addis Abeba — Somalia’s parliament speaker Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur has called for closer security cooperation with Djibouti, saying the stability of the two neighbouring countries is inseparable amid growing tensions across the Horn of Africa.
